headline: Kaynes consistently delivered on major revenue milestones and strategic business expansion, while shifting focus on cash flow and segment-specific timelines over successive quarters.

promises.promise: Will eliminate smart meter receivables before the year ends.
promises.quote: So going forward, we will make sure that before this year is over, we get rid of these receivables with appropriate financing so that it's not in our books
promises.evidence: Management did not mention the elimination of smart meter receivables in subsequent calls after the year ended.

promises.promise: Approximately INR240 crores of receivables will be discounted.
promises.quote: So, we are quite confident that INR240 crores, approximately INR240 crores of such receivables will anyway get discounted and it'll reduce the amount.
promises.evidence: Management did not provide an update on discounting receivables in later calls.

promises.promise: Working capital normalization measures are underway and expected to show visible improvement.
promises.quote: Working capital normalization measures are already underway and expected to show visible improvement going forward.
promises.evidence: Management maintained and reported net working capital improvement targets such as bringing down NWC to 85 days by March 26.

promises.promise: Expects about INR300-odd crores in second half execution.
promises.quote: And then, of course, in the second half, we also plan some execution, which will be of the nature of about INR300-odd crores.
promises.evidence: Reported H2 FY26 revenue was significantly higher, easily exceeding INR300 crores.

promises.promise: We maintain our guidance of bringing down net working capital to 85 days by March 26.
promises.quote: And secondly, w e maintain our guidance of bringing down the net working capital to 85 days by March '26.
promises.evidence: No explicit final NWC days figure was reported in subsequent calls to verify the exact 85 days target.

promises.promise: We will cross about INR4,000 crores minimum for FY26.
promises.quote: So, in terms of revenue, I think last quarter is going to be a busy quarter for us, and including the last quarter for FY '26, we'll cross about INR4,000 crores minimum and mainly driven by EMS revenues.
promises.evidence: Total revenue for FY26 stood at INR3,626.4 crores, missing the INR4,000 crores minimum target.

promises.promise: We are still sticking to our $1 billion revenue projection for fiscal 28.
promises.quote: See, on the growth, what we have projected $1 billion, we are still sticking on to that because for us, from our bare board, from our OSAT, additional buildings are going to take place.
promises.evidence: The horizon is fiscal 2028, which has not ended yet.

promises.promise: At consol level we will definitely be OCF positive by end of this year.
promises.quote: And going forward, at consol level, we'll definitely be OCF positive by end of this year.
promises.evidence: Management reiterated the commitment to turn cash positive by the end of the financial year in Q1 FY27.

promises.promise: The smart metering business should do around INR700 crores to INR800 crores of revenue.
promises.quote: You guided for the full year, the smart metering business should do around INR700 crores to INR800 crores of revenue.
promises.evidence: No further updates or figures were provided for smart metering full-year revenue in subsequent calls.

promises.promise: Both units remain on track to be operational by quarter 3 FY27.
promises.quote: Both Kaynes Semicon Unit 2 and Kaynes Circuit Chennai remain on the track to be operational by quarter 3 FY27
promises.evidence: The horizon of Q3 FY27 has not ended yet as the latest reported data is for Jun 2026 (Q1 FY27).

shifts.change: Management guided to cross a minimum of INR4,000 crores in Q3 FY26, but reported actual FY26 revenue of INR3,626.4 crores in Q4 FY26.

shifts.topic: Operating Cash Flow / Cash Positive Timing
shifts.change: Shifted the expected timeline to turn cash positive from 'by end of this year' (FY26) to 'by the end of the financial year' (FY27).
